reviews.snippet: I book an auto through the app and waited for around 10 minutes for the driver to arrive. However, after reaching my destination, the app showed that I had to pay additional waiting charges. If the driver had actually been waiting for me for 10 minutes, I would understand and be willing to pay the extra amount. But in this case, I was the one waiting for the driver, and I was still charged waiting fees. This is completely unfair and frustrating. Please check your waiting-time calculation system

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Nayana, we’re sorry to hear about the waiting charges added to your ride even though you were waiting for the driver. Please reach out to us through the Help & Support section in the app with your ride details so we can check the waiting-time calculation and assist you further.

reviews.snippet: Horrible experience with the app. would NEVER recommend. Booked a trip 24 hours prior, and Driver was allotted the next day (boasted the usual 0% cancelations etc.) And then they canceled 15 mins before the ride. With no alternate arrangements in place. No alternate driver/ ride on place. I missed my flight because l couldn't find another arrangement. And there's not even a forum to complain or seek redressal because they do not have cancelation issues, they claim. Have some shame.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Aravind, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. We would like to understand your concern better and assist you further. Kindly reach out to us at support@nammayatri.in with the relevant details so we can look into the matter.

reviews.snippet: Certain locations are shown incorrectly to drivers despite my pinning the point accurately. I have had to pay extra multiple times due to this. For remote areas and by lanes, this is still acceptable, but certainly not for areas like Manyata Tech Park. Also, if a booking takes a long time, the fact of whether or not a ride has been confirmed vs the user having to re-initiate a booking, needs improvement; it's not always clear on the UI.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Geethanjali, thank you for the detailed feedback. We'll pass both these concerns to our tech and product teams. Please write to support@nammayatri.in with your ride details so we can also look into the extra charges for you.

reviews.snippet: No accountability, there is no response from support even after 1 year but app still shows they are working on it. Recently you have introduced congestion charges which is always keeping the prices higher even if there is no one on the road. UPDATE: I have raised the queries already in the app but you guys don't look at that. UPDATE: as your will you increase the prices. UPDATE: Can't rely on your pricing, randomly shows 18 and 19 rs per km. Duration charges are not valid.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Abhay, we’re truly sorry that your concerns have remained unresolved despite you reaching out through the app. We understand your frustration around the lack of response and the fare and congestion-charge concerns, and we’ve taken your detailed feedback seriously for review with the concerned team.

reviews.snippet: This was my go to app before but now most of my bookings get cancelled. The worst experience was, I booked a return trip to my home on a friday evening and as the wait time was long it got cancelled. But after about half hour, it started to book by itself by the time I had alredy booked and started in another. It was booked 3 times out of which 2 times I got yelled at badly as they thought i was double booking. It only stopped after i logged out of my profile. Please see this does not happen

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Anjana, we’re truly sorry for the experience you had with the repeated bookings and cancellations. We understand how upsetting and confusing this must have been, especially when drivers thought you were double booking. Please write to us at support@nammayatri.in with the details, and our team will look into this and assist you further.

reviews.snippet: Alright booking app. Not too great though. For instance, it shows longer and more convoluted routes that cost extra, and have 'stop and pick-up charges' that cost 20rs to just stop at your destination and pick up. However it provides live tracking to others and billing details and once drivers accept on a price, it doesnt change. Acceptable app and honestly better than most out there.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Manya Jain, thanks for your detailed feedback. We’ve noted your concerns on routing and stop charges and will work on improving it.

reviews.snippet: The app books autos even after showing the search timeout screen and doesn't notify the user. This has happened multiple times, leading to awkward situations with auto drivers. This is despite the marketing notifications being endless. Please give users an option to block marketing notifications. It's a transportation app, I'm not going to plan to go out based on a notification

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: We’re sorry for the inconvenience caused. Please share the details with us at support@nammayatri.in so the team can investigate this further and assist you better.

reviews.snippet: Recently a new issue has come up with this app. If the driver send a message as arrived in the app, then automatically Waiting charge starts to calculate. This problem I faced 2 times in a week. the ride was away in the tracker, but driver sent message as arrived and waiting charges started increasing. Second problem is that it automatically starts booking ride if I cancel the ride due to some reason. Therefore now I have uninstalled the app.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi there, we’re sorry to hear about these issues with the app. We understand your concerns about waiting charges starting before the driver arrives and the ride getting booked again after cancellation. Please reach out to us through the Help & Support section in the app.

reviews.snippet: The fare is much higher than other apps for the same distance. Earlier there was an option to choose between different autos based on the fare, but that option has been removed. It shows a fare range, but now all autos choose the highest fare and we have no way to choose the fare. The only way is to cancel the booking and rebook, but after doing that a few times, it blocks our account and logs us out with no way to log back in. This app has now become a platform for auto drivers to scam people.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: We're always looking to improve your experience. Any specific incident we can look into for you? Let us know by reaching out to support@nammayatri.in so that we can get in touch with you and resolve the issue.

reviews.snippet: The app keeps crashing ,lagging and hanging. I book a ride, the driver arrives at the location but the app doesn't even show it is booked yet. It shows it is still looking. I have to keep refreshing the app. Drivers get mad at us when we cancel because it got booked somewhere else. But we don't even know it is booked for a whole 2 mins. Also, the prices are insanely higher than other applications and we do not have any settings to make adjustments to these prices. Namma yatri is robbing us.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi there, we're sorry for any discomfort caused due to app glitch. Please reach out to us at support@nammayatri.in. We'll look into the concern raised.

reviews.snippet: Worst experience. The price initially quoted 126-146rs, as soon the ride got confirmed, it changed to 176rs. The ride was confirmed immediately as soon as I booked it, so there's no chance that i price increased due to time. I don't understand why don't they quote the actual price rather than changing it after the ride has been booked. The app was super reliable when it has began, but recently the prices are way too high compared to other similar platforms.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Suman, We’re closely working on redefining pricing and have noted your feedback. Please write to us at support@nammayatri.in. We're here to assist you.

reviews.snippet: Easy-to-use app with fast ride booking. However, I noticed that drivers have the option to mark “arrived at location” even before reaching the pickup point. In my case, the auto was nearly 900 meters away but was marked as arrived. It took more than five minutes to actually reach the pickup spot. The app also mentions that waiting charges will apply post five minutes, even though I booked the ride only after reaching the location. Was forced to cancel the ride and opt for a new ride.

This is the worst app i ever used in my life. It is a complete waste of time. It will show driver assigned, but when we check driver will be moving in some different direction. We will keep on waiting for the vehicle and at the end they will cancel the ride. Today I waited around 1 hour and different drivers assigned and all cancelled and some are moving in some different direction. Also the cost is very high compared to other apps. If you want to waste money and time go for this.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Similiya, we apologize for the inconvenience. This is unusual and we will surely look into this. Could you please share your contact details with us on nammayatri.support@juspay.in so that we can get in touch with you and resolve the Issue.

reviews.snippet: They have showed a different price in the beginning of the ride and increased the amount at the end of the ride and this happened to me twice. Customer care is also not supportive and you can't call them from your end. They will take ages to investigate on the issue and then come up with idiotic excuses and will not solve the issue. The app is also not UI friendly, you can't see the drop time. Prefer uber over this app the customer support is best there and able to solve the issues.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hey Debika, Sorry for the inconvenience. Please provide your ride details at support@nammayatri.in, and we will investigate the pricing issue promptly. Your feedback on app usability is noted.

reviews.snippet: It was good at the beginning. Now there is hardly any quality control. Rides are much more expensive and the good drivers are a rarity. Auto drivers will accept the rides and then don't show up and continue going on some other routes. Ride acceptance is very low unless you add tips. Even with tips it's not much better. Sad demise of an application that worked really well in the past but doesn't anymore.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Kapil, we regret the inconvenience caused. Could you please share your contact details with us on support@nammayatri.in so that we can get in touch with you and resolve the issue

reviews.snippet: The accountability from the app's customer support and the drivers (not all but it only takes one) are abysmal. Be careful if you're using this app. I left my earbuds in a cab. the cab driver didn't pick up my calls and was picking up calls from other numbers. The app customer support couldn't reach him, and I lost the earbuds. This makes me wonder if there is anything they'll do in an emergency. I'll move away from this app.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Soumya, We’re really sorry to hear about your experience. This is certainly not the service we aim to provide. Please share the details of your ride via our support email at support@nammayatri.in, and we’ll look into this immediately. Your feedback is important to us, and we’re committed to resolving this issue.

reviews.snippet: Drivers take longer routes due to which the fare increases. There's no way to report that. Additionally, I can't cancel the ride but they can so they arrive at pickup and cancel. With the new update, there's a very annoying sound alert once you get a ride and when the ride starts. The volume increases to its highest level. Even after disabling notifications, it rings. This is highly inconvenient and invasive. The app is glitchy in general.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hi Nupur, we regret the inconvenience caused. Could you please share your contact details with us on nammayatri.support@juspay.in so that we can get in touch with you and resolve the issue.

reviews.snippet: Not a very great experience with Namma Yatri. It might be convenient for long distance,but for something like 2-4km travel, there's a huge waiting time. Infact, without paying "the tip" no Auto driver would accept the ride. If this is the case, then I see it no different from other cab/auto aggregators. It is just another app to the list of already existing apps on your phone.

App is good, just fix the fare at the time of booking, if we take 1 wrong turn also, the fare increases. The price should be set at the time of confirming auto and little margin should be there for slight changes in distance. Past 2 rides I had to pay more than what was shown at the time of booking. Other reviews are also highlighting this issue.

Hey, why did you stop giving the option to choose multiple drivers while booking? Multiple drivers used to quote multiple fares and customer had the option to choose the lower fare. Now it's pretty straight forward and no option to choose. It's not an useful update. The one thing that separated you guys from other auto booking app is this feature. Now I do not have any reason to book from your app. I'd like this reviewed and bring back the old option.

response.title: Moving Tech
response.snippet: Hello Sandip, if you encounter any issues with the application, please reach out to us at nammayatri.support@juspay.in. Thank you!

what_s_new.snippet: Now even smoother ⚡️ From app launch to live tracking, performance is up and friction is down - so you can book and go faster.
